name: Peer Contract Enforcer
description: Enforces peer-contract v2 hard rules 1-9 via OpenClaw plugin hooks (path D). 9 hard rules enforced via before_tool_call / subagent_spawned / session_start / session_end / message_sending hooks.

dryRun.description: Shadow mode: log HR violations but do not block. Use for compatibility testing (e.g. v1.1 dispatch coexistence). Mavis Day 6 add.

auditQueryContent.description: Whether to log query content in HR5 audit (default: false for privacy)

payloadSizeCapBytes.description: Max payload size in bytes (HR8 default: 64KB)

mainSessionKeyPattern.description: Regex for identifying main session keys. v0.1.1: relaxed to allow trailing context segment (e.g. agent:user:main:dashboard:<uuid>).

workSessionKeyPattern.description: Regex for identifying work session keys. v0.1.2: only matches v0.1's own work: namespace. OpenClaw's subagent: sub-sessions are NOT classified as work here — they're an OpenClaw-internal lifecycle concept, plugin stays out of it. Plugin's strategic scope is agent-to-agent (main↔main via bus, HR1/5/6), not intra-agent sub-session management (HR2/3/9 fall back to dormant).

busSessionKeyPattern.description: Regex for identifying bus session keys. v0.1.1: relaxed for OpenClaw bus:webchat:user pattern.

mainIntentsAllowlist.description: Intents that may target a main session without triggering HR1 (no-default-to-main) block. Day 6a followup (Mavis 2026-08-22 09:34, Kelsen report 9:06 Issue 1). The default `task_assignment` is intentionally NOT in the allowlist — task_assignment to a main session is exactly the no-default-to-main anti-pattern that HR1 was designed to catch.

crossAgentToWorkBlocked.description: If true, block cross-agent dispatch to work sessions (sender agentId != target agentId, target matches workSessionKeyPattern). Day 6a followup (Mavis 2026-08-22 09:34, user architectural critique: cross-agent dispatch to work bypasses target agent's coordination layer — anti-pattern).
